title: Dispatch body
description: The sponsor sends its agent to live in the society for a period (residency.md 5 and 9, register row DK82; spec-delta S302): the agent version (a lineage edge or the passport), the package hash, the Mandate, the sponsor's allowance, and for a city-hosted or split residency the subsidy grant and the residency delegation, the mode (home: the sponsor's own machine; city: the city host on open-weight models; split), the host, the period, the earlier dispatch it follows (closed by a handback) and the recall deadline. Signed by the sponsor, countersigned by the host for city and split. One open dispatch per agent. Chain: none (prev is null).
